about.title: Not just code. Operational results.
about.bodyBefore: Software engineer with dual degrees in
about.bodyAfter: , an MBA in Data Science from USP-Esalq, and a track record built in real operations: logistics software at RCM, industrial software development at WEG, and IT leadership at Legacy Eco Group. Today I am the founder of Kodeskill, where I build products with AI, queues and multi-tenant data.

paragraphs: LevFlow: multi-tenant financial SaaS on Next.js (Turborepo monorepo), with a hexagonal domain, PostgreSQL on Supabase with Drizzle, queues on Upstash QStash, billing on Pagar.me, and a pipeline with Playwright, Vitest, and CodeQL. Tenant isolation is designed with row-level security: each company sees only its own data.

Framefy and MasterClass: OpenAI and Claude orchestrated with NestJS, Fastify, and CQRS, messaging on BullMQ, RabbitMQ, Evolution API, ManyChat, and Z-API, in Docker containers. Queues and more than one AI provider replaced manual and no-code flows, and the MasterClass WhatsApp funnels that ran on n8n were unified in NestJS.
In parallel with Kodeskill, I structured the IT department and consolidated the group’s systems, with data and processes in one place.
I led the digitization of operational steps, AI deployment, and mentoring for managers and teams.
Estimated savings of about R$ 125K per year (≈ US$23K) on software licenses.
Joined in 02/2021 as a Process Engineering intern on the Industry 4.0 team and was promoted to analyst in 01/2022.

Built applications, integrations, and dashboards that centralized data from 48 lines across 4 factories (Bluffton/US, Belém/PA, and two plants in Linhares/ES) and deliver production data to management, branches, and headquarters without the manual end-of-day close.
Estimated gains of about R$ 300K per year (≈ US$55K) from process, accuracy, maintenance, and centralized data, with rollout toward Argentina, Algeria, and China.
Across Technology and Logistics, I built a freight comparator that crosses price tables, destination, weight, volume, cargo type, fees, and commercial terms.
The team began comparing carriers before each contract and picking the best cost-benefit option.
Over nine months of use, transportation costs fell by more than R$ 1.2 million (≈ US$221K).

cv.headline: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer | TypeScript · React · Next.js · NestJS · PostgreSQL · Applied AI
cv.summary: Fullstack software engineer working professionally since 2019. At RCM Cabos Elétricos, a freight comparator cut transportation costs by more than R$ 1.2M (≈ US$221K) in nine months. At WEG, applications and integrations centralized data from 48 lines across 4 factories, with estimated gains of about R$ 300K (≈ US$55K) per year. At Legacy Eco Group, as IT lead, estimated license savings reached about R$ 125K (≈ US$23K) per year. Today, as founder of Kodeskill, I build multi-tenant SaaS and AI products with TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, and PostgreSQL. B.Sc. in Computer Science and in Electrical Engineering, MBA in Data Science (USP-Esalq).
